en: The postcard features a historical cityscape with a river running through the middle, at least two bridges crossing the river, and a prominent hill crowned by fortress structures and a clock tower. There are many classical European rooftops and a church tower with a clock. The foothill and buildings are labeled, and handwritten text appears at the bottom. The sepia tone and old-fashioned design indicate it is quite old.
